'''Elrit trees''' were massive trees that could grow to have a diameter of several hundreds of meters. They were taller then they were wide and soared above the surrounding landscape. Common on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]], these trees were capable of supporting immense tree-cities within their boughs. Their red-hued leaves were large and tough.
